//: Pins the build to a .NET 8 SDK.
Without this, `dotnet` selects the HIGHEST SDK installed on the machine. GitHub's
windows runners ship newer SDKs alongside the one setup-dotnet installs, so CI was
compiling with a different Roslyn — and therefore a different analyser set — than a
developer running the identical command locally. The symptom was a build that is
clean on a workstation and fails CI on a rule that never fired at home, which is the
worst kind of red: nothing local reproduces it.
rollForward latestFeature keeps this on .NET 8 while still accepting any 8.0.x a
contributor happens to have, rather than demanding one exact patch nobody has.
